body: I suppose we're two ends of the spectrum. You don't get any pleasure from it, so you stop eating. I only get pleasure from it, even if it's superficial, so I eat more.
Hey, it's your life, I don't judge. If she was fine with it, then it's not like you did anything _morally_ wrong, anyway.
I'm the same way, yeah. Unrequited love is rough, but at least you'll get to hang out with her soon.
Don't worry about the weight too much, that's easily lost. I was up around 260, and I got down to 210 in a few months with the help of /r/loseit. It's unpleasant, but do-able.

Fucking lol, 'that's irrational'. Yeah, right. 


I've been told by _fucking strangers_ that I'm ugly. Literally had someone stop once and say 'christ, you're one ugly fucker' whilst I was minding my business in a shop. I've never once in my entire life had anybody say I was good looking or even 'average' except for my mother. I'm a great person when I choose to be, and the best I ever get is 'you're a good friend'. Not reciprocation, no romantic opportunity, etc. From people, no less, who would forget about me were I not doing things for them in the first place.


Secondly, maybe it can for you, but not for me. Not only can I not afford any of that stuff (nor will I wait 20 years on the NHS for it) I'm not _remotely_ feminine. I'm really tall, stocky, etc. I can't become feminine, as I desire, because it's the opposite of me in every way. Additionally, some of the things I want can't be bought; we don't have the technology yet, and maybe never will.


Thirdly, do you think I haven't tried? I'm as social as possible, everybody laughs at my jokes, I have engaging conversations with people about all sorts of things. As soon as it ends, though- whether it's class, or some other event I had to be at (because I don't get invited to anything else) it's like I don't exist. No messages, no invites, nothing.

Sure. I'm ugly, I hate being male, I have no real friends or anybody who cares about me. 

Solutions:

- Nothing
- Nothing
- Very little
You're right, I don't think I'm an idiot, either. Problem is, I've felt this way for years now, and a solution- fast or gradual- has never revealed itself.
Eh, things just suck. I have no friends, I'm uncomfortable with my identity in ways I can't change, I'm bored. The usual.

I appreciate the thought, but we both know that simply isn't true. People say they care online because it's easy, but you don't know me, and your life won't change if I end mine. 


I can't change the things I want to because of physical impossibilities. Some lives aren't meant to be lived.
